An '''iron shovel''' is the [[Iron equipment|iron]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], crafted from [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. It mines at speed 8 and has 500 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/iron_shovel.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/iron/shovel</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines shovel blocks at speed 8 (vanilla: 6).

=== Combat ===

It deals 4.5 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>
